method: Real JavaScript engine + app driven by normal logical or DOM events; Canvas/DOM are explicit test adapters. No browser pixels or physical controller claim.

checks.name: Eight exposed cycles have 10/28/16 ticks, no damage or resource bonus, and resume held movement
Airborne, crouching, guarding and attacking states reject a taunt without cancelling their action
A melee impact interrupts the gesture; a held guard cannot remove its vulnerability
A remote tar attack interrupts a taunt without suppressing the ordinary projectile mechanics
Pause freezes the gesture; resume and stop do not leave an active gesture
The private-room clock ignores the new action and keeps its existing checkpoint fields
Legacy recordings stay version 1; taunt recordings use v2 with both old J2 and new gesture codes intact
Legacy remapping migrates only missing taunt keys, preserves collisions and persists deterministically
Keyboard, tactile and L3 share the new logical action; excluded contexts never emit it
Selection previews do not confirm; replacements, mirror choices and independent outfits keep their own identity
Rapid selection cleans previous timers; reduced motion retains the same choice and removes exiting ghosts
Duel touch controls expose taunt while Boss controls exclude it
Base taunt art is never loaded for Mama viaduc; a stale outfit from a different fighter cannot hide a valid base gesture
